## Primary Analysis

### Poisson — Overdispersion Check

```{r poisson-check}
check_poisson(nb_result$m_pois)
```

### Negative Binomial Model

```{r nb-model}
# check_od(nb_result$m1)
check_mc(nb_result$m1)
interpret_nb(nb_result$m1, term = "treatment",
             outcome    = nb_result$dep_var,
             comparison = nb_result$comparator_group)
```

```

```

## Outcome Distribution

```{r dist-setup}
ds <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(treatment_name = factor(treatment_name,
                                 levels = c(nb_result$target_drug, nb_result$comparator_group)))

n0 <- ds %>% filter(!!sym(nb_result$dep_var) == 0) %>% nrow()
nt <- ds %>% nrow()
subtitle_base <- paste0(nb_result$study_cohort_label, " | ", nb_result$period_name,
                        " | n0 = ", comma(n0), "/", comma(nt),
                        " (", percent(n0 / nt), ")")

my_range <- if (startsWith(nb_result$dep_var, "n_med")) 1 else 10
my_min   <- 1

ds_cut <- ds %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(value_cut = my_cut(!!sym(nb_result$dep_var), my_range, my_min)) %>%
  ungroup()

cut_levels <- ds_cut %>%
  arrange(!!sym(nb_result$dep_var)) %>%
  pull(value_cut) %>%
  unique()

ds_cut <- ds_cut %>%
  mutate(value_cut = factor(value_cut, levels = cut_levels))

# Privacy masking: cells representing fewer than 11 individuals are clamped
# to a displayed value of 10 ("<=10") and rendered at reduced opacity.
mask_threshold <- 11
mask_value     <- 10
mask_alpha     <- 0.4
```

### Count Distribution

```{r dist-count, fig.width=20, fig.height=8}
ds_count <- ds_cut %>%
  count(value_cut, treatment_name) %>%
  mutate(masked    = n < mask_threshold,
         display_n = if_else(masked, as.integer(mask_value), n),
         label_n   = if_else(masked, "<=10", comma(n)),
         bar_alpha = if_else(masked, mask_alpha, 1))

y_max <- max(ds_count$display_n, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

ggplot(ds_count, aes(x = value_cut, y = display_n,
                     fill = treatment_name, color = treatment_name,
                     alpha = bar_alpha)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_n),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5, colour = "black", size = 5, alpha = 1) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  labs(title    = nb_result$study_cohort_label,
       subtitle = subtitle_base,
       x        = nb_result$dep_var,
       y        = "Count") +
  ylim(0, y_max) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20)
```

### Percentage Distribution

```{r dist-percent, fig.width=20, fig.height=8}
ds_pct <- ds_cut %>%
  count(value_cut, treatment_name) %>%
  group_by(treatment_name) %>%
  mutate(group_total = sum(n),
         pct         = n / group_total,
         masked      = n < mask_threshold,
         masked_pct  = mask_value / group_total,
         display_pct = if_else(masked, masked_pct, pct),
         label_pct   = if_else(masked,
                               paste0("<=", percent(round(masked_pct, 3))),
                               percent(round(pct, 3))),
         bar_alpha   = if_else(masked, mask_alpha, 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

y_max_pct <- max(ds_pct$display_pct, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

ggplot(ds_pct, aes(x = value_cut, y = display_pct,
                   fill = treatment_name, color = treatment_name,
                   alpha = bar_alpha)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_pct),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5, colour = "black", size = 5, alpha = 1) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  labs(title    = nb_result$study_cohort_label,
       subtitle = subtitle_base,
       x        = nb_result$dep_var,
       y        = "Proportion") +
  ylim(0, y_max_pct) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20)
```
